messages:
Lina Gomez: Hi everyone! Lina here, joining as ML infra eng. I'm mostly remote but in SF Tuesdays/Thurs. Big fan of spicy food and mechanical keyboards. Desk reservation TBD. Excited to meet y'all :wave:
Samira K.: Welcome Lina!! :tada: We have a hot-sauce club (not a cult, I promise). Also keyboard hill: we are divided into tactile vs linear.
Ethan B.: Yo Lina 1 welcome! I'm Ethan (platform). If you're in on Tuesday let's do lunch at Tacoria across the plaza. Also sharing earbuds is a hard no.
Carlos (Facilities): Hey Lina 1 Welcome to the office. If you're coming in, I can reserve a hoteling desk for your Tuesdays/Thurs. Need ergonomic wrist rest or laptop riser?
Lina Gomez: Thanks all! I'd love a riser and a wrist rest if available. Also curious if anyone brings their dog? I have a very judgmental corgi pic I will spam later. :dog2:
Samira K.: We have a rotating pup day. Tag @people-ops to add you to the rota. And yes please send corgi pics. :heart_eyes:
Ethan B.: Quick FYI: parking in the garage is free after 6pm but mornings are tight. Carlos can help with temporary passes if needed.
WelcomeBot: Lina Gomez joined the workspace. Orientation checklist emailed. Don't forget 2FA setup. :robot_face:
Lina Gomez: Orientation noted, will complete the checklist tonight. Also — any recommendations for mechanical keycaps? Asking for a friend :keyboard:
Samira K.: GMK sets are gorgeous but expensive. Drop by my desk I'll let you try my switches.
Carlos (Facilities): Riser and wrist rest added to your desk provisioning ticket. You'll get an email when it's ready.
Lina Gomez: Perfect, thank you! See some of you Tuesday for lunch. P.S. my corgi's name is Mochi, HE IS A NOISY EATER.
